data.name: About.PhilisaAbafaziBethuMeaning
data.value: Philisa Abafazi Bethu, okuthetha “philisa abafazi bethu” ngesiZulu, yasekwa ngo-2009 liqela labafazi abanoluzuko basezindeni ezisemantla eKapa ababebona abamelwane babo bebandezelekile bengenamxhasi. Into eyaqala njengenkqubo encinci yokondla kwiholo yecawa ikhule yaba yenye yemibutho yentlalontle yoluntu ebanzi kakhulu eNtshona Koloni.

data.name: About.OverYearsExpandedReach
data.value: Ekuhambeni kwexesha, siwandisile ukufikelela kwethu ukusuka kukhuseleko lokutya ukuya kuxhaso lobundlobongela obusekelwe kubulili, uphuhliso lolutsha, intlalontle yabantwana, nokhathalelo lwabadala, sikhulisa inethiwekhi yeenkqubo nabalingane ekwenza kube lula kumalungu oluntu ukufikelela kwiinkonzo zethu.

data.name: About.TodayServeOver14
data.value: Namhlanje, sisebenzela iintsapho ezingaphezu kwe-14,200 ngonyaka kwiindawo ezili-12, ngeqela elizinikeleyo labasebenzi nabavolontiya abangaphezu kwama-320.

data.name: About.CommittedProvidingAccessibleDignified
data.value: Sizinikele ekubonelelweni ngeenkonzo zoncedo ezifikelelekayo, ezinesidima, nezibanzi ezijongana neengcambu zobuhlwempu, ukungalingani, nokungabandakanywa kwezentlalo, sinika amandla abantu neentsapho ukuba bakhe ubomi obuzinzileyo, obanelisayo.

data.name: About.EnvisionSouthAfricaWhere

data.name: About.LucindaEvansDreamProtecting
data.value: Lucinda Evans' dream of protecting and empowering abused women and children became real the day she saw a crowd gather around a man beating his wife in the street; everyone watching, yet no one stepping in to stop it.

data.name: About.SinceThenLucindaHas
data.value: Since then, Lucinda has worked to become the person her community can lean on for protection and reassurance. Based in Lavender Hill, she is determined to ensure that the women and children there always have a place that offers them hope, even in their most difficult circumstances.
